notes.title: Martial Law: Our Spring Demo – Now Available for the People!
notes.content:
[h2][b]New in store:[/b]
[i]Martial Law: Our Spring DEMO[/i]
Condition: [b]brand new[/b]
Price: [b]1 entertainment coupon (expired, but no one checks)[/b]
Quality: [b]...present[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Straight from the warehouse – a fresh demo of [i]Martial Law: Our Spring[/i] has just hit the Steam shelves. Is it a rare good? Not yet. But you never know with these shortages.[/h3][h3]What’s inside:
– Around 30 minutes of gameplay (or more, if you overthink every dialogue option)
– A brand new top-down perspective – yes, now you can actually see the queue
– More talking, more choices, more mild existential dread
– A bigger map, more PRL, still no discounts[/h3][p][/p][h3]Is it high quality?
Hard to say. The standards are classified.[/h3][h3]No ration card required – but feel free to pretend you have one.[/h3][h3]
Pick it up “from the store” here:[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643590/Martial_Law_Our_Spring_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Already playable on the train
notes.content:
Hello there,

As promised, we have for you ports of the Martial Law game for phones. From now on you can play this game anywhere you want. And you don't have to take a monitor with you....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/9acded332f6d6416df2c45cd60adbf7e461f0384.jpg[/img]
source: [i]https://www.reddit.com/r/funny/comments/74aeu3/when_you_bought_a_ps4_instead_of_a_switch_but/[/i]

If there would be any mistakes in the port, inform us on discord. This is our first port to phonesːDogefaceː

iOS:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/martial-law/id6471831730

Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.fixer.martiallaw
[h1]
New Martial Law[/h1]

The new game, [i]Martial Law: Our Spring[/i], will be shown after Christmas/New Year's.  We got sick a few people and did not make it before Christmas, sooo sorry ːfeelingː.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/5a8e7fbb6068c47fe5245a29b9bc865119b7c612.png[/img]

Graphic designers have stated that they will even reproduce the cracks on the wall.... Crazy

Oh, and it will be possible to make [u][i][b]moonshine[/b][/i][/u]. ːganstaː

Let's take this opportunity to wish you all a merry Christmas and a happy new year. ːHappyPugmasː

~FIXER Group
